acceptance: Tests (fake clock/fetch) cover: producer in_progress then success -> proceeds; in_progress beyond the cap -> fails with a clear message; concluded failure -> fails immediately; 503 then success -> proceeds; three 503s -> fails; 404/403 -> no retry; digest mismatch -> no retry
The total added wait is bounded below the job timeout (assertion or test)
Provenance and digest verification code paths unchanged (diff review recorded)
PR merged in benchbox-site under that repo's gates (required checks green)
context: Program: autogen-issues-decisions-20261018 (decisions D1-D11 and guardrails G1-G12; read it first). description:
Site repo items (BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site): read that repo's AGENTS.md first and follow its worktree, test and PR rules (G2); decision D6 authorizes PRs and merges there.
Confirmed: site run 39137456105 failed at 'deploy resolve' with 'bundle:fetch: producing run concluded null' (scripts/bundle-fetch.mjs producingRunErrors line ~24 requires conclusion success). The core site-inputs run 39137257094 dispatches from inside its build job, so the consumer can start before the producer run has a conclusion; that run completed successfully (updated 14:56:34Z) after the consumer failed (14:47:37Z). Why its conclusion stayed null for 100+ seconds after its jobs ended is UNEXPLAINED (record any finding). Separately run 38933325082 failed on 'gh run download ... site-deploy-receipt-...: HTTP 503: 503 Egress is over the account limit' (deploy/lib/github.ts downloadReceipt ~line 80) with no retry.
Work: (1) when the producing run status is not completed, poll with bounded backoff until it completes (total wait cap 10 minutes, well under the 45-minute job timeout), then require conclusion success; a producing run that concluded failure/cancelled/timed_out fails immediately with no wait; (2) retry artifact and receipt downloads on HTTP 5xx and network errors only, at most 3 attempts with 5/15/45 second backoff; never retry 4xx, digest mismatches or gate failures; log each retry.
Guardrails: the digest and provenance checks are untouched; retries are bounded and visible; no change that treats a failed producer as success.
